items.statement: US real activity is accelerating or decelerating.
items.falsifier_template: A sustained reversal in industrial production, payrolls and the registered nowcast would overturn this claim.

items.statement: US growth downside risk is elevated or contained.
items.falsifier_template: The lower conditional growth quantile normalizes, or repeated out-of-sample tail exceedance frequency materially misses its registered nominal rate and downside pinball loss no longer beats the unconditional baseline.

items.statement: US inflation is accelerating or decelerating.
items.falsifier_template: Core and headline inflation momentum reverse across multiple releases.

items.statement: Energy innovations are adding to or subtracting from near-term inflation pressure.
items.falsifier_template: The registered local-projection response becomes statistically and economically negligible.

items.statement: US financial conditions are easing or tightening.
items.falsifier_template: NFCI and the registered yield/activity system reverse direction.

items.statement: The US labor market is tight, balanced or soft.
items.falsifier_template: Payroll, unemployment and wage evidence reverse together across multiple official releases and the registered out-of-sample labor forecast deteriorates.

items.statement: Treasury debt-stock and rate co-movement is strengthening or weakening without an identified causal interpretation.
items.falsifier_template: The registered debt-and-yield system becomes unstable or its direction reverses across the pre-registered window and specification checks.

items.statement: State house-price growth and unemployment are conditionally associated in the fixture.
items.falsifier_template: The coefficient is unstable across registered windows and covariance specifications.

items.statement: The registered fiscal, term-premium, real-rate and inflation-compensation evidence indicates whether 10-year Treasury yield pressure is rising or falling.
items.falsifier_template: The direction is overturned if the registered Treasury-yield programme reverses across fiscal, term-premium, real-rate and inflation-compensation specifications or fails its out-of-sample benchmarks.
